textual.potential_relevance: The promised profits and 'HUGE returns' are directly linked to deploying a contract, connecting a wallet, sending at least 50 Matic, confirming fees, and starting the bot; this relationship may require later assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish the identity or trustworthiness of the contract, the destination or use of the funds, the authenticity of the claimed profits, or any actual outcome for viewers.
